title: I still think they should just make Son of a Witch tbh #wickedmovie #...
transcript: I was very surprised by this new wicked news and I wanna talk about it because it has long been rumored that Stephen Schwartz and Winnie Holtzman, who wrote the musical and movie versions of wicked, would write some kind of musical follow up given the success that wicked has had both on stage and screen. And in this new interview, Steven Schwartz confirms that he and Winnie are working on a new Oz project, but it's not going to be related to wicked at all. Instead, it is going to be an adaptation of the second book in L. Frank Baum's Wizard of Oz series called The Wonderful Land of Oz. And rather than subverting the story that, you know, in the way that wicked does, this is just going to be a straightforward adaptation and to be much closer to Oz as envisioned by L. Frank Baum rather than Gregory Maguire. And that's why I'm kind of confused because they just spent two movies trying to build out this wicked Oz universe, put so many new characters and lure right for exploration, and it seems like they're essentially just going to throw that away and start from scratch in a new Oz. And don't get me wrong, I am very excited to see some of the other Oz novels getting some love. Frank Baum wrote 14 Oz books and the only one that really seems to get adapted is The Wizard of Oz. I just don't know that This makes a ton of sense as a follow up to wicked, and if they were going to adapt the story of Ozma of Oz, I'd kind of like to see a completely new creative team take a stab at it, especially given that the original songs in wicked weren't that good. What? Who said that? Also, speaking of original songs in wicked, in this same interview, Stephen Schwartz said that he would like to see the girl in the bubble added to the wicked stage musical moving forward. And I would just like to say no, that's a very bad idea. Please don't do that.
